steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: Ow... if it weren't for these Sinners...

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: Ted, how dare you let your men get infected with Mania... Do you... have any idea what the consequences are?!

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Who are you to talk to when you have defected to a Sinner?

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: I'm tired of you guys having your way... I'll do anything to get those monsters out and bring the old Syndicate back.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Let's go, Chief. Let's go find that R.
He suddenly struggles and grabs your ankle. You can't break free of the cold, solid prosthesis.

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: Brand and Laura... Our field team never came back after they went out for a rescue. What happened?

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: Please, Laura... is in so much pain, please...

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: Dr. Brand went to save lives, the lives of you all who are besieging SALVA and killing each other. The man always carries out surgery with precise timing, yet he didn't come back on time...

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: What did you do to him?!!!

options: Did he go to save someone?

steps.content: Ted kicks him off and pulls you to one side.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: What are you zoning out for? They're our enemy, Chief. Don't forget which side you're on.
You turn around sharply. From the direction you came, a wobbly figure came out of the smoke.
You recognize that face and the bloodstained white robe.
